2.1. om_integration.api¶

This module provides the main API for this package.

Functions

get_stored_generic_intg_rules()

Returns a string with the the generic integration rules configured at the time when IntegrationConfig.store_config was last called.

get_stored_intg_namespace_separator()

Returns the namespace separator was configured at the time when IntegratinConfig.store_config was last called.

get_stored_proj_intg_rules()

Returns a string with the project specific integration rules configured at the time when IntegrationConfig.store_config was last called.

Classes

IntegrationConfig(programs, om_packages[, …])

Configuration object for integration with the PiSPEC object model.

Exceptions

IntegrationError

Base class for exceptions raised by this module.
